title: Amodei, Altman, Musk Call for Slowing AI Model Development
description: Leaders of the world’s biggest artificial intelligence platforms said it’s time to slow the development pace of their most advanced — and most lucrative — models, citing escalating risks of the technology.

title: Tesla Teases Oct. 1 Event to Showcase Next-Generation Roadster
description: Tesla Inc. teased an Oct. 1 event to showcase its next-generation Roadster vehicle, a niche product that CEO Elon Musk first unveiled in November 2017.

title: OpenAI’s Altman Says No IPO in 2026, Firm to Prioritize Safety
description: OpenAI won’t go public in this year as the artificial intelligence company focuses on addressing safety-related concerns around the technology, Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman told Fortune in an interview.
